apps.localizedDescription:
English summary:

Unofficial native iOS (arm64) port of Rigs of Rods, built from the full upstream source on free GitHub Actions macOS runners. Touch controls, a compact HUD with light and indicator lamps, and a sideloadable IPA. Download the latest build from the latest-ipa release and install it with SideStore, Sideloadly, or ESIGN. Rigs of Rods itself is GPLv3 software by the Rigs of Rods Team; this repository only adds the iOS port and build pipeline.

versions.localizedDescription:
An .app whose bundle contains a top-level directory named resources (or Resources) is refused by the iOS installer with the generic “Unable to Install”, while the very same directory under any other name (zzz/, Base.lproj/, rorres/) installs and runs. The packaging step therefore ships game data in RoR.app/rorres instead of resources.

A truncated download makes every installer fail, and the error looks like a build problem (“Truncated input file”, “Unable to Install”). Compare the byte size of the file you downloaded with the list below; if it differs by even one byte, download the file again.
